# John Computer Science - University of Mississippi

> Academic profiles and course materials for computer science faculty and students at the University of Mississippi, specializing in programming languages, functional programming, machine learning, and GPU computing.

This is the faculty and course resource hub for the Department of Computer and Information Science at the University of Mississippi. It hosts faculty profiles, academic publications, and course materials from leading researchers in programming language design, machine learning, and high-performance computing.

## Key Topics

- Functional Programming
- Object-Oriented Design
- Predicate Logic
- Machine Learning
- GPU Computing
- Programming Languages
- Computer Networking
- Academic Resources
- University of Mississippi
- H. Conrad Cunningham
- David A. G. Harrison
- Byunghyun Jang
- Course Materials
- Interpreters
- Data Analytics

## Faculty Profiles

- [H. Conrad Cunningham](https://john.cs.olemiss.edu/~hcc): Professor H. Conrad Cunningham's academic profile at University of Mississippi
- [David A. G. Harrison Academics](https://john.cs.olemiss.edu/~harrison): Faculty profile for David A. G. Harrison with machine learning and networking focus
- [Prof. Byunghyun Jang](https://john.cs.olemiss.edu/~bjang): Prof. Byunghyun Jang's faculty page covering GPU computing and HEROES Lab

## Course Materials

- [CSCI 581: Object-Oriented Design and Programming](https://john.cs.olemiss.edu/~hcc/csci581oo/csci581.html): CSCI 581 course syllabus and materials for object-oriented programming

## Optional

- [Thoughts for Our Day](https://john.cs.olemiss.edu/~hcc/thoughts.html): Personal reflections and inspirational thoughts by Prof. H. Conrad Cunningham
